reviews.text:
This is the Starbucks branch in Doosan Tower, visible from the front. It's not easy to get a seat because the store isn't that big, and you'll have to be very lucky to get a seat on the terrace, which is especially popular.

The "Ham & Arugula Sandwich" was served warm, and it was the most delicious Starbucks sandwich I've ever had. We recommend eating it for brunch. 4 points.

The "BLT Sandwich" wasn't served warm, but it tasted pretty good. 3 points.

“Strawberry Yogurt” and “Dolce Latte” both taste similar to other Starbucks branches.

There are Starbucks stores that are popular for their natural views, such as the Bukhansan branch, but this one seems to have a much better view of the city than any other Starbucks branch I've been to. Of course, it is difficult to find a seat on the terrace, but it is well worth the challenge.

reviews.author: mj w
reviews.text:
⚾️This is a cafe I visited while dreaming of the Lotte Giants winning⚾️.

You can get there quickly by walking up a slightly uphill alley from the main road.

I ordered drip coffee (Kenya) and cheesecake, and if I ordered hot coffee, they gave me one cup in a coffee cup and one in a bottle.

There are 4 types of coffee beans, and you can choose one according to your taste.

Desserts include cheesecake and banana pudding, and the cheesecake had a nice rich taste and a texture between soft and moist. I visited after a meal and didn't get to try the pudding, so I definitely plan to try it on my next visit.

I didn't notice time passing as I sat at the window seat, read a book, and listened to the conversation between the customer and the owner. (Lotte fans’ heated conversation about baseball)

It's a great place to visit Dongmyo and relax while drinking delicious coffee or tea.

reviews.text:
Are you looking for a Yajang chicken restaurant in Dongdaemun?
It's hard to find a place like this with Gwanghee view on one side and DDP view on the other.

This is Eulji Fried Chicken in Dongsa Station, famous for electric fried chicken and yakjang.
We ate fried chicken... but it was fried in clean oil.
Even the well-maintained draft beer was good.

Also, the famous chicken radish that the owner promoted himself.
They say they make it themselves, but it also contains a lot of Cheongyang peppers.

I looked up the reviews and found that I came here because of the friendly owner.
It’s a chicken pub with a lot of regulars!
(It’s no secret that the owner is the building owner^^)

If you go to Dongdaemun History and Culture Park and DDP, go there!

reviews.text:
I went to Samchildakbal Euljiro Main Branch in Euljiro, Seoul, and it was really great.

This is a famous chicken feet restaurant in Euljiro, and the taste lives up to its reputation. The spicy chicken feet had a rich flavor and smoky aroma, and there was no unpleasant smell at all. It is especially delicious when eaten with soju.

If you are looking for a proper Korean restaurant near Euljiro 3-ga, I highly recommend Samchildakbal Euljiro Main Branch. The lively space with a local atmosphere made the dining experience even more enjoyable.

Highly recommended to anyone visiting Seoul who wants to try spicy Korean food and chicken feet.
Samchildakbal Euljiro Main Branch is definitely worth a visit.

reviews.author: Lee Na-hyeon
reviews.text:
I highly recommend Project D, a real pizza that you can enjoy while looking at the view of Gwanghuimun.

The food itself tastes like the original ingredients, making it light and delicious! The view is so pretty that it's great to come with a lover or on a date haha.
The 6th floor has a high ceiling and a luxurious feel, like a high-end wine bar! I will come again on a nice day to enjoy the rooftop! I had the Mushroom Meat Pizza and the Alfredo, and I really recommend it. It's the Mushroom Meat, but it has more meat. I was so full and the pizza dough was really delicious. I think you could just make the pizza dough into bread and sell it separately. It's really great.
The owner is so kind, the view is pretty, and the food is delicious, so I'll be a regular for the rest of my life 🩷 Oh, there's a cocktail that pays homage to pizza, and the liquor is nice and soft!! Dongdaemun History Park Station pizza restaurant Project D highly recommended for a date❤️

reviews.author: seungmo kim
reviews.text:
The Buyer Lounge, located on the 4th floor of DDP Fashion Mall in Dongdaemun, is the perfect place to take a break while shopping.
Anyone can use it for free as long as they have a same-day purchase receipt, and you can have time to recharge in a comfortable and sophisticated atmosphere like an airport lounge.

This place has gone beyond a simple resting place and has been renovated into a complex cultural space where K-fashion, K-food, and K-culture come together.
Hot coffee and drinks, as well as nostalgic K-food snacks, are provided free of charge, adding to the enjoyment of shopping.

There is also a meeting space for fashion officials, increasing business efficiency.
If you want a special experience and comfortable relaxation in Dongdaemun, we recommend you visit the Buyer Lounge.

reviews.author: Jeong Ji-young
reviews.text:
I went to the Black and White Chef restaurant one after another, but I went to Euljiro Jewel yesterday and was very disappointed, and this place was also not good, so I thought it would be really annoying...  Oh my... I ordered a total of 7 dishes, including dessert, and they were all delicious.

I guess everyone who goes to the finals has a reason. Excellent
Unusual food can be repulsive, but even though it was unique, it was delicious. However, the dessert wasn't my style, but it's worth considering that one of the seven is average!

You should really go there

I visited two “Black & White Chef” restaurants back-to-back. After being hugely disappointed at Euljiro Boseok yesterday—and thinking, “If this place is bad too, I’m really going to lose it”—I came here… and wow. We ordered seven dishes including dessert, and every single one was delicious.

There really must be a reason this place keeps making it to the finals. It’s outstanding.

Sometimes unusual or experimental dishes can feel off-putting, but here they were unique and genuinely tasty. The dessert wasn’t really my style, but hey—if one out of seven is just okay, that’s still impressive.

You should definitely go. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Irena
reviews.text: I am satisfied with all the dishes I ordered. The Avalon dish was boiled gently and had a good oil flavor, and the truffle butter dish went well with the wine. The olive ice cream I ordered for dessert was also a new experience. The crunchy olive candy was a kick. At that time, our table was prepared a little late, but Chef Namno Yoon was very attentive even though he was very busy, so the waiting time felt short. It was a satisfying meal.

reviews.author: B K
reviews.text:
A dining bar run by a chef who became famous as a hookback chef.
The exterior is modern and clean.
I was guided to the second floor, and the second floor felt more spacious and comfortable than the first floor.
The food menu is one page long, including desserts, and the wine selection is enormous.
There are many wines with a certain price range.
The dishes feel rather cost-effective.
The food menu was rather limited, so it was easy to choose.
I ordered one entrée, one seafood, one main, and one dessert from the menu, and I was satisfied with everything.
With this taste and this price, there is no reason not to visit again.
It's just difficult to make a reservation...
The service is good and I am satisfied with everything.

The food is fun and delicious.
Foods that showed off the chef's imagination, such as abalone cooked like snails, sourdough served with truffle butter, Parisian gnocchi that looked like chewing crispy air, and chicken made like a sundae by putting it in pig intestines, gave a unique pleasure.
The sommelier's wine recommendation was also perfect. If you like wine, I recommend going.

reviews.author: Jiyoon
reviews.text:
You can feel the traditional atmosphere from the outside, and it was so amazing to open the amulet door and go in. There was a lot to see inside, so I kept looking around.

I was even more excited because the cocktail menu was based on the 12 zodiac concept.
We tried sheep and rabbit.

The portion contains white rum, melon, broccoli, lemon, and cotton candy.
It was so sweet and sour that I really liked it. I thought it was cute that they used cotton candy to represent wool.
The rabbit is based on plum and yogurt lemon, so it has a nice scent and goes down smoothly.

The tofu snack that came as a basic snack was savory,
I was really satisfied with the truffle fries as they were crispy and had a subtle flavor.

It was fun to watch as the bartender made it right in front of us.
Overall, the atmosphere and taste were both good.

If you are looking for a unique and atmospheric cocktail bar in Hongdae,
I recommend Jushindang :)

A bar where you can choose from a variety of drinks and food to order.
It is offered at a reasonable price for a light meal and enjoyment. You can also order wine by the glass, but if you order by the glass, you have to pay for it. If you purchase by bottle, you can use it without additional charge :) You can also order food, so there were many people ordering a bottle of wine at the table with simple food and enjoying it. Doota branch is basically open late, so it seems okay to use it in the second round! The sign looks a little hard to read, but it is located on the right side of the food court.

reviews.author: Jiyeong Kim
reviews.text: It was nice to be able to enjoy wine in a comfortable space at a cost-effective price, but it was disappointing that there were different types of wine to choose from, and it would be nice to have more explanations about the wine.

reviews.author: W P
reviews.text:
A wine bar on the second basement level of Doosan Tower in Dongdaemun. A place with clear advantages and disadvantages.

Pros: Good transportation. One of the cheapest places to drink wine in Seoul. The wine selection is popular and it is easy to find a wine that suits your taste. You can taste and choose from a variety of wines. A good place for a wine dinner.

Cons: A lot of the food is instant and you wonder if it goes well with the wine. It is not an atmosphere that suits us when we think of wine. A wine glass that interferes with the taste of wine.
